title: selinum archangelica
intro: Selinum archangelica, commonly known as Angelica, is a biennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The health benefits of Angelica include its use as a diuretic, a treatment for digestive issues, and as an antiseptic agent to aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Angelica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve liver and kidney function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Angelica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
